items.title: $9.8K → $9.5M: How $WALLET Generated 970X Trading Volume on MEXC in 28 Days
items.summary_short: $WALLET spent $9,800 and generated $9.5M in MEXC trading volume - a 970X return in 28 days. No gimmicks, just automated rewards that attracted ~200 daily traders. The most efficient CEX campaign ever: $1 spent per $970 traded.
